theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid m)) (R η : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → 0 < η → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ ρ : Euclid m → ℝ, Continuous ρ → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) → (∀ z, δ < ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) → ∫ z, ρ z = 1 → ∫⁻ v in ball (0 : Euclid m) R, ‖(∫ z, ρ z * F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (v - z)) - F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) v‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal η
